definitions.explanation: An organized body of soldiers, ranging from a small squad to a large force. By extension, any organized team dispatched for a task.

examples.japanese: {部隊|ぶたい}が{出動|しゅつどう}した。
{特殊|とくしゅ}{部隊|ぶたい}が{現場|げんば}に{向|む}かった。
examples.english: A special unit headed to the scene.

examples.japanese: {救助|きゅうじょ}{部隊|ぶたい}が{被災地|ひさいち}に{派遣|はけん}され、{昼夜|ちゅうや}を{問|と}わず{活動|かつどう}した。
examples.english: A rescue unit was dispatched to the disaster area and worked around the clock.

notes:
{部隊|ぶたい} refers to an organized military unit, but is also used figuratively for any task team or squad.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特殊|とくしゅ}{部隊|ぶたい}: special forces unit
- {部隊|ぶたい}を{派遣|はけん}する: to dispatch a unit
- {機動|きどう}{部隊|ぶたい}: mobile unit; task force

USAGE:
Not to be confused with its homophone {舞台|ぶたい} (stage), written with different kanji.
